brief_snapshot.timeline: FY2026 — complete through P5 Approval & Mobilization before execution starts outside AbarVa
brief_snapshot.program_name: Core Banking AI Operating Model & Analytics Modernization
brief_snapshot.target_outcome: Faster digital banking product analytics delivery, improved data trust for fraud and servicing signals, and a fundable roadmap with clear execution phases — with analytics cycle time, data lineage completeness, model deployment lead time, payments/fraud signal latency, servicing insight adoption, and rework rate as baseline measures.
brief_snapshot.problem_statement: Brindlemark's digital banking product delivery is constrained by slow analytics cycles, uneven data trust across core banking, payments, fraud signals, customer servicing, and product analytics domains, and the absence of a strategy-to-funding path before execution starts. Core banking, payments, fraud signals, customer servicing, and product analytics operate in silos, creating rework, delayed insights, and a blocked funding path for product teams. Baseline evidence will include analytics cycle time, data lineage completeness, model deployment lead time, payments/fraud signal latency, servicing insight adoption rate, and rework rate.
